title: TypeSomething closing CTA (v2)
description: A wide warm-ink panel with big rounded corners (48px, 24px on phones) on warm paper, lit by a faint dusty-pink glow top-left and a faint lime glow bottom-right. Centred: a light white heading whose second line can be the bold-and-lime wordmark, a softened paragraph, a lime pill button and a tiny tracked fine-print line.
notes: the panel wears the dark class, so it is dark in light and dark mode alike (it is a dark panel by design)
